name: Stimulatory adenylate cyclase-PKA-CREB arm without cAMP turnover
rationale: All members are adenylate cyclase activation (dopamine receptor, forskolin) to cAMP, PKA and CREB; unlike its superset neighbour it lacks PDE1 cAMP degradation, DARPP-32 and negative feedback.

name: cAMP synthesis-to-degradation cycle with PDE1 and DARPP-32 feedback
rationale: Members span cAMP synthesis, PKA and CREB activation plus cAMP catabolism (Cam-PDE1), DARPP-32 and negative regulation of cAMP/PKA, which the core activating-arm neighbour lacks.

core: Adenylate cyclase inhibition by alpha-2 adrenoceptors
name: Adrenaline alpha-2 receptor Gz/Gi core of adenylate cyclase inhibition
rationale: All four members describe adrenaline acting through alpha-2 receptors and Gz/Gi to inhibit adenylate cyclase; it is the minimal core, lacking the PLC-calcium and secretion terms of its superset neighbour.

name: Gi/Gz cyclase inhibition with PLC-IP3-calcium and secretion control
rationale: Members combine alpha-2/Gz inhibition of adenylate cyclase with G protein calcium signalling, PLC/IP3 regulation and restraint of epinephrine secretion and exocytosis, which the 4-member core neighbour lacks.

name: Leucine and glucose starvation sensing by mTORC1
rationale: All members concern amino acid (leucine) and energy (glucose, LKB1-AMPK) control of TORC1; unlike its superset neighbour it has no AKT-TSC growth-factor input or methionine sensing.

qualifier: AKT-TSC growth factor plus nutrient inputs
name: AKT-TSC, amino acid and energy inputs converging on mTORC1
rationale: Members cover leucine, methionine and glucose/LKB1-AMPK sensing plus AKT inhibition of the TSC complex (and an LKB1/TSC2 module), the growth-factor arm absent from the nutrient-only neighbour.

name: Amyloid fibril, tau tangle and microglial activation regulation
rationale: Members regulate amyloid fibril formation and APP synthesis/catabolism and additionally neurofibrillary tangle assembly, microglial activation and glucosylceramide catabolism, which the core amyloid neighbour lacks.

core: Amyloid fibril assembly and APP turnover
qualifier: bidirectional core, no glial or tau terms
name: Bidirectional amyloid fibril assembly and APP turnover control
rationale: All members are positive/negative control of amyloid fibril formation and APP synthesis and catabolism (with obsolete amide-metabolism terms); it lacks the tau, microglial and amyloid-beta clearance terms of neighbours.

name: APC, AMER1 and AXIN scaffold mutants plus CTNNB1 phosphosite mutants
rationale: Members are the beta-catenin phosphorylation cascade and its cancer mutants, including APC truncations and AMER1 deletions/truncations that the phosphosite-only neighbour lacks.

core: Beta-catenin phosphorylation and its escape mutants
name: CTNNB1 phosphosite and GSK3beta mutants escaping destruction-complex phosphorylation
rationale: Members are the beta-catenin phosphorylation cascade with CTNNB1 S33/S37/T41/S45, GSK3B and AXIN missense mutants; unlike its superset neighbour it has no APC or AMER1 scaffold lesions.

name: Prefoldin-to-CCT/TRiC chaperonin folding of nascent actin and tubulin
rationale: All members are the prefoldin handoff and CCT/TRiC folding of actin and tubulin; unlike its superset neighbour it stops at the chaperonin stage without post-chaperonin tubulin cofactor folding.

name: CCT/TRiC plus post-chaperonin cofactor folding of tubulin and actin
rationale: Members cover de novo folding, prefoldin and CCT/TRiC folding of actin and tubulin plus the post-chaperonin tubulin folding pathway that the chaperonin-only neighbour lacks.

name: Mitotic centromeric cohesion protection and its anaphase release
rationale: All four members concern mitotic centromeric cohesion, its regulation and its resolution and separation; it lacks the cohesion establishment, maintenance and meiotic terms of its superset neighbour.

qualifier: establishment through separation, mitotic and meiotic
name: Mitotic and meiotic cohesion establishment, maintenance and release
rationale: Members span establishment, maintenance, centromeric (mitotic and meiotic) cohesion and its resolution, adding establishment, maintenance and meiosis to the mitotic-release core neighbour.

name: Cerebellar granule and Purkinje layer formation with locomotor behavior
rationale: Members are cerebellar layer formation, granule precursor proliferation, Bergmann glia, nigral development and walking/motor learning; unlike its superset neighbour it lacks proprioception, motor neuron survival and neural RNA-binding terms.

name: Cerebellar, proprioceptive and motor neuron basis of movement
rationale: Members combine cerebellar layer formation and locomotor behavior with proprioception, voluntary movement, motor neuron survival, hindbrain differentiation and collateral sprouting absent from the cerebellar-only neighbour.

name: Centromeric CENP-A deposition and prophase-prometaphase chromosome condensation
rationale: All members are mitotic/meiotic chromosome condensation or CENP-A nucleosome deposition at centromeres; it lacks the replication-coupled nucleosome assembly of its superset neighbour.

name: Chromosome condensation with CENP-A and replication-coupled nucleosome assembly
rationale: Members include condensation and CENP-A deposition plus DNA replication-dependent chromatin assembly, nucleosome organization and chromatin-binding terms that the condensation-centromere neighbour lacks.

name: Cohesin loading, chromatin looping and the sister chromatid cohesion cycle
rationale: Members span cohesin loading, chromatin looping, cohesion establishment and maintenance through resolution; unlike its superset neighbour it has no negative regulation of cohesion.

name: Cohesin cohesion cycle including negative regulation of cohesion
rationale: Members are the cohesin loading-to-resolution cycle plus negative regulation of sister chromatid cohesion and mitotic-phase terms, which the positive-only neighbour lacks.

name: ER exit-site COPII cargo export with Golgi vesicle tethering
rationale: Members are COPII cargo loading and ER exit-site export with vesicle targeting/tethering (and COPI retrograde budding); unlike its superset neighbour it lacks COPI anterograde and intra-Golgi traffic.

name: Bidirectional ER-Golgi traffic including COPI anterograde and intra-Golgi transport
rationale: Members cover COPII export, COPI retrograde return and additionally COPI anterograde and intra-Golgi traffic, which the COPII-focused neighbour lacks.

qualifier: hypermutation and early B cell development, no class switching
name: Cytidine deaminase editing in hypermutation and early B cell development
rationale: Members are DNA/RNA cytidine deamination in somatic hypermutation, V(D)J, pre-B and B lineage commitment plus antiviral restriction; unlike its superset neighbour it lacks isotype switching and APOBEC3G-HIV terms.

qualifier: class switching and APOBEC3G HIV restriction
name: Cytidine deamination in hypermutation, class switching and APOBEC3G HIV restriction
rationale: Members span AID/APOBEC deamination in hypermutation and B cell development plus IgA/IgG isotype switching and APOBEC3G resistance to HIV-1, which the hypermutation-only neighbour lacks.

qualifier: all four classes from intestinal absorption
name: Intestinal fat absorption and chylomicron, VLDL, LDL, HDL lifecycle
rationale: Members cover dietary lipid digestion and absorption with assembly, remodeling and clearance of chylomicrons, VLDL, LDL and HDL; unlike its superset neighbour it lacks sterol/vitamin E transport and sitosterolemia terms.
